name: Pocket Note Quiz
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Run "Start quiz on current note" and choose "Only wrong" to review the questions you marked wrong.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Pocket Note Quiz is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for studying with it.
